caption: The drawing is composed of a series of outlined sewing pattern pieces and explanatory text, all rendered in fine black lines on a light, cream-colored background. The pattern pieces are labeled with capital letters and numbers, and are arranged within a rectangular border. The individual objects depicted include several irregularly shaped templates labeled as A, B, C, D, and F, which correspond to components named "front bodice," "under arm piece," "½ back bodice," "sleeve," and "center back of bodice." There are also smaller geometric shapes labeled G, G1, G2, G3 for bows and H for a velvet trim, as well as two pocket-shaped pieces labeled I and J for skirt components. A zigzag-edged strip labeled H runs horizontally. Near the bottom are instructions in capital letters identifying each pattern piece and what it represents, including information about sewing, pleating, and trim placement. Dotted lines and notations are used on certain patterns to indicate fold lines, pleat placements, and stitching details. A small horizontal scale marked "1/8" is shown in the lower right corner. The lower section contains a key matching the labels to pattern parts and additional notes, while the upper portion is filled with the outlined templates, several of which have directional notes or further sub-labels written inside or alongside the shapes. The entire drawing is monochromatic with the only color contrast coming from the black ink on the pale background.
title: Dress and Lace Collar - Pattern
